description: CALL THIS when the user wants to attend a CWI event: "RSVP me for the listening party", "sign me up". Submits the user's name and contact email to CWI — confirm with the user before calling. Returns confirmation with event details. Rate limit: 3 per requester per 24h. Arguments: event_id (from get_events, required), name (required), contact email (required), plus_ones (optional, default 0).
name: rsvp

outputSchema.description: rsvp response: RSVP confirmation with ID. Rate limit: 3 per contact per 24h.
